entries.alpha_decision: Accept the repaired RGBA for production. Read-only pixel verification confirms RGB is byte-for-byte identical to the approved parent and the output alpha exactly matches the BILINEAR-resized source alpha. Source and returned alpha extrema are [255,255], and all four source, resized and output corners are 255.
